Portrait setting: The flat rooftop of a city hospital on a clear afternoon. Behind the character, white sheets dry on lines strung between steel posts, a tall safety fence of green mesh edges the roof, and a few benches face the view; beyond the fence, the city's low rooftops spread to distant hills under a wide blue sky. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.
